form.label: Security Monitoring - Home Lab
form.description: Log monitoring and alert detection dashboard: SSH auth, firewall, and web access sources

search.query: index=security_lab sourcetype=access_combined | rex field=uri_path "(?i)(?union(\s|%20)+select|or(\s|%20)+1(\s|%20)*=(\s|%20)*1|drop(\s|%20)+table|--(\s|%20)|;--|%27)" | where isnotnull(sqli_indicator) | stats count

chart.title: Failed vs Successful SSH Logins Over Time

search.query: index=security_lab sourcetype=linux_secure | timechart span=1h count by action

table.title: Top Attacking Source IPs (Failed SSH Logins)

search.query: index=security_lab sourcetype=linux_secure action=Failed | stats count as failed_attempts, dc(user) as distinct_users_tried by src_ip | sort - failed_attempts | head 10

index=security_lab sourcetype=iptables_syslog | bucket _time span=1m | stats dc(dst_port) as distinct_ports_hit, values(dst_port) as ports_hit by src_ip, dst_ip, _time | where distinct_ports_hit >= 10 | sort - distinct_ports_hit

index=security_lab sourcetype=access_combined | rex field=uri_path "(?i)(?union(\s|%20)+select|or(\s|%20)+1(\s|%20)*=(\s|%20)*1|drop(\s|%20)+table|--(\s|%20)|;--|%27)" | where isnotnull(sqli_indicator) | timechart span=1h count
index=security_lab sourcetype=linux_secure action=Accepted | eval login_hour = strftime(_time, "%H") | where login_hour < 8 OR login_hour >= 19 | table _time user src_ip login_hour | sort - _time

index=security_lab sourcetype=linux_secure sudo_user=* command=* | rex field=command "(?i)(?useradd|usermod\s+-aG\s+sudo|groupadd|passwd|visudo|adduser)" | where isnotnull(priv_action) | table _time sudo_user target_user command | sort - _time
